summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing a series of share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and in the U.S. between May 22 and June 10, 2026. Repurchases were executed in HKD (approx. HKD 42.44–45.01 per share) and USD (approx. USD 5.30–5.76 per share), with varying daily volumes. The filings show no change in total issued shares because repurchased shares had not yet been cancelled as of each closing date. The company is actively returning capital to shareholders through ongoing buybacks. Watch for future cancellations and continued repurchase activity.
